nodes.label: onnx_parser
nodes.desc: parse_from reads the protobuf; parse_graph walks nodes and subgraphs, parsing tensors and attributes into instructions.

nodes.label: op_parser registry
nodes.desc: register_op_parser stores a handler per ONNX op name; each parse_*.cpp file registers itself at static-init time.

nodes.label: module
nodes.desc: add_instruction/insert_instruction build the instruction list; modules nest for control flow and fused regions.

nodes.label: program
nodes.desc: compile() (L380) runs the chosen target's passes; eval() (L697) feeds a parameter_map and returns device arguments.

nodes.label: pass_manager
nodes.desc: run_passes (L240) applies each pass to every module with a tracer and mandatory dead-code cleanup between stages.

nodes.label: target registry
nodes.desc: register_target (L56) inserts into a static name map; lookup_target is what compile resolves 'gpu'/'cpu'/'ref' against.

nodes.label: load_save
nodes.desc: save (L61) writes the compiled program plus parameter shapes into an MXR file for deployment without recompilation.

nodes.label: propagate_constant
nodes.desc: Folds constant subgraphs into literals before codegen, shrinking the graph the backend must handle.

nodes.label: dead_code_elimination
nodes.desc: apply (L38) removes unreferenced instructions; runs after nearly every other pass in every pipeline.

nodes.label: fuse_pointwise
nodes.desc: apply (L487) chains elementwise ops into single gpu::pointwise instructions to cut kernel launches and memory round-trips.

nodes.label: schedule
nodes.desc: apply (L533) partitions instructions into concurrent streams using dependency weights for async execution.

nodes.label: memory_coloring
nodes.desc: apply (L300) assigns allocation offsets so live tensors share one scratch buffer without overlap.

nodes.label: gpu target
nodes.desc: pipeline_factory (L177) builds dynamic_shapes/required/optimize/fusion/backend lists; get_passes (L359) stitches them per gfx arch; name 'gpu' at L410.

nodes.label: compile_ops
nodes.desc: apply (L985) routes each op through compile_plan (L432) candidates; compile_manager (L774) handles tuning and caching decisions.

nodes.label: compile_miopen
nodes.desc: apply (L68) resolves miopen_op convolution/pooling plans from MIOpen's find API for the current problem descriptor.

nodes.label: compile_hipblaslt
nodes.desc: apply (L46) finalizes hipblaslt_op GEMMs with heuristic algorithm selection and workspace sizing.

nodes.label: fuse_ops
nodes.desc: match-based fusion, e.g. conv+bias+relu (L445 matcher, apply_conv_bias L452); rewrites matched windows into fused gpu ops.

nodes.label: code_object_op
nodes.desc: Runtime op wrapping a compiled HIP code object; compute (L76) launches the kernel with packed arguments.

nodes.label: jit pointwise compiler
nodes.desc: pointwise_compiler (L60) interpolates the pointwise_kernel template (L38) into HipRTC source covering pointwise/contiguous/copy ops.

nodes.label: kernels/pointwise.hpp
nodes.desc: Header-only device library: pointwise() (L54) walks the index space with tile strides, included verbatim into generated source.

nodes.label: binary_cache
nodes.desc: Persistent store for compiled code objects: get (L131) / insert (L154) back onto file or SQLite backends keyed by codegen hash.

nodes.label: hipgraphify
nodes.desc: apply (L255) captures the launch sequence into HIP graphs to amortize per-launch CPU overhead.

nodes.label: cpu lowering
nodes.desc: cpu_apply (L306) extends generic ops to dnnl-named variants (dot, convolution, eltwise) plus native fallbacks like cpu_op (L135).

nodes.label: cpu/dnnl.cpp
nodes.desc: oneDNN bridge: converts MIGraphX shapes and types into dnnl::memory descriptors and format tags (L80).

nodes.label: ref target
nodes.desc: Portable scalar reference kernels; the ground truth driver verify compares GPU and CPU results against.

nodes.label: C API
nodes.desc: extern C surface: migraphx_program_compile (L2430) and migraphx_program_run (L2516) wrap the C++ objects; migraphx.py binds it for Python.

nodes.label: driver commands
nodes.desc: verify command (L1004) diffs against ref with reduce/bisect options; perf command (L1143) reports per-op and end-to-end timings.

nodes.label: perf timing
nodes.desc: time_run (L143) loops the program over parameter maps and reports milliseconds for benchmark tables.
